saved_evidence.description: The Mayor's executive order commits the City to Vision Zero, records the sixty nine people killed on Albuquerque roadways in 2018, names the departments and partner agencies joining the effort, and pledges the City to the framework.
saved_evidence.evidence: Rendered, because the file has two pages and two bytes of extractable text. Headed EXECUTIVE ORDER, PROCLAIMING THE CITY'S COMMITMENT TO END ALL TRAFFIC FATALITIES AND SEVERE INJURY ACCIDENTS IN ALBUQUERQUE THROUGH PARTICIPATION IN THE VISION ZERO PLEDGE, signed by Timothy M. Keller. Records sixty nine individuals killed on Albuquerque roadways in 2018 and cites the Complete Streets Ordinance, O-14-27, enacted in 2015. The filename dates it 2019-09-04.
